title: Two-sided field-cube search with a nonlinear occupancy certificate

claims.statement: For the explicit systematic field-cube code u -> (u,u^3) over the binary field with modulus X^1000+X^53+X^45+X^34+1, using the two-sided candidate decoder with systematic radius 111 and parity radius 109 in proof.md with numerical ties, the average block error on uniform 1000-bit messages over 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 55200736201330827/1000000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same code and two-sided decoder uses at most the integer W=33943*(sum of binom(1000,i) for i=0 through 111)+484839*(sum of binom(1000,i) for i=0 through 109)+227 operations on every received word, with W <= 2^(102763/200).

experiments.purpose: Verify irreducibility, geometric cube-root exponent and third root of unity, exact occupancy-based error bound, memory and integer exponent comparison, and representative inverse arithmetic identities.
